name: How long does it take to fix a sewer smell problem?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a sewer smell problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to fix a sewer smell problem depends entirely on the cause. Simple issues like a dry P-trap can be resolved in minutes. Clearing a minor drain clog might take an hour or two. More complex problems, such as repairing a cracked vent pipe, could take a few hours to a full day, potentially requiring wall access. Major sewer line repairs involving excavation or extensive pipe replacement can take several days to a week or more. A professional diagnosis will provide a more accurate timeline for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixing sewer smells can take minutes for simple issues like dry P-traps, or several days for major sewer line repairs.
